cohort: Singletons conceived through frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) with or without laser-assisted hatching (LAH) treatment, born to couples with infertility.
finding: At 4-6 years of age, singletons conceived via frozen-thawed embryo transfer with laser-assisted hatching had comparable physical, metabolic, cognitive (FSIQ), and behavioral (GAI) developmental outcomes to those without LAH.
